query: Alright, I'm hunting for UHT milk, the ready-to-drink kind, and it's gotta come from Australia (I'll check the label myself, don't you worry). Y'all can't go over 390 cts, and I mean that to the penny (student loans ain't gonna pay themselves, and that price is the top of my trail). And I want one you actually have on hand there, not just something listed on a website somewhere out in the fog. If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks).

rules: Use no more than 38 moves; no extra switchbacks.
